invariants: delegated support is time bounded, tenant scoped, explicitly authorized and fully evidenced
break-glass support requires step-up authorization evidence and a stricter maximum duration
support access never creates permanent tenant roles or bypasses PC5 authorization truth
support actions and recovery actions are append-only evidence and do not rewrite business truth
recovery cases coordinate diagnosis and recovery evidence without becoming source truth for the affected domain
merchant and platform health are derived observations only and never mutate operational or financial state
health snapshots preserve evidence references and worst-status aggregation without inventing causal truth
sensitive secrets and credentials are forbidden from generic support and recovery metadata
exact command replay remains scope-aware and fail-closed
